work_title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull

places.name: Yale University
places.connection: Filming location for Indiana Jones's workplace, 'Marshall College'. The chase sequence through the campus library and on a motorcycle was filmed here.

places.name: Iguazu Falls
places.connection: The spectacular waterfalls that the characters drive over in an amphibious vehicle multiple times were filmed at this real location on the border of Brazil and Argentina.

places.name: Hilo, Hawaii
places.connection: The lush jungle landscapes of the Amazon in Peru were primarily filmed on the Big Island of Hawaii, near Hilo.

places.name: Yale University (as Marshall College)
places.connection: Filming location for the exterior shots of Marshall College, where Indiana Jones works as a professor.

places.name: Iguazu Falls
places.connection: Used for the multiple waterfall plunges during the amphibious vehicle jungle chase sequence.

places.name: Hilo
places.connection: The lush rainforests near Hilo provided the primary backdrop for the Amazon jungle scenes.

places.name: Deming Municipal Airport (as Hangar 51 exterior)
places.connection: This airport and its hangars stood in for the exterior of the secret 'Hangar 51' military base in Nevada.

places.name: Ghost Ranch (as Nevada desert)
places.connection: The distinctive red rock formations of Ghost Ranch were used for the scenes in the Nevada desert, including the 'Welcome to Nevada' sign.

places.name: Fresno Chandler Executive Airport (as Nazca Airport)
places.connection: This airport served as the filming location for the Nazca, Peru airport where the characters first arrive.

places.name: Universal Studios Hollywood Backlot
places.connection: The 'Doom Town' nuclear test site was a set constructed on the studio's backlot.

places.name: Downey Studios (as Akator Temple interior/exterior)
places.connection: The massive sets for the Akator temple interiors and exteriors were built and filmed at this studio complex.

places.name: Palais des Festivals
places.connection: The film held its world premiere at the Cannes Film Festival on May 18, 2008.

places.name: Chapel Street
places.connection: Site of the motorcycle chase sequence involving Indy and Mutt fleeing Soviet agents through the streets of the university town.
